title: Capability
description: What a device CAN do — reported on /devices/register each session. The server uses this to compute the effective logging_config: effective = intersection(plan_profile, capability) + per-device overrides (invariant 3). Per remediation 1.4, the legacy `supported_features` summary is removed; this schema is the sole source.

timestamp_sources.description: Available clock sources on this device. mono and utc are universally present; gps presence depends on hardware/permissions.

supports_ping.description: Device can run ICMP/UDP/TCP-SYN latency probes (first-hop gateway + operator-pinned targets). Present on both Logger and Monitor enrollments.

monitor.description: Present only on MP Monitor enrollments; absent on MP Logger enrollments.

serving_cell.description: Per-sample fields the device can report for the serving cell.

RadioCapability.description: Out of MVP scope on the Pixel 9 Pro (per CLAUDE.md): cqi/mcs/bler/harq/drx/bwp/mimo_layers/tx_power — all default false. Extended-capability devices (rooted, OEM diag builds) may set them true.

QosCapability.description: All false on Pixel 9 Pro baseline; out of MVP scope.

explicit_ho_events.description: If false, handovers are derived retrospectively from PCI/NCI changes in radio.parquet.

MonitorCapability.description: MP Monitor–specific capabilities. Absent on Logger enrollments.

supports_vpn_capture.description: Device can create a VpnService tunnel for passive traffic capture.

can_list_apps.description: Device can enumerate installed apps via PackageManager and push an AppList.
